findings.title: Candidate models taker execution; Bosona is 81% maker
findings.claim: Candidate assumes 100% taker execution (ask+fee) but Bosona reality shows 81% maker fills (by count), 71% by quantity, with maker cash PnL +$6,021 vs taker -$1,593.
findings.evidence: results/execution_model_taker_vs_maker.json: 4387/5441 BTC15m fills are maker (fee≈0), 1054 are taker (fee≈0.07*p*(1-p)). candidate.py:12-15 unit_cost() always adds taker fee. Late additions (t=600-899): 1099/1173 maker (93.7%).
findings.affected: All 21 candidate entry scenarios and 1 addition scenario model wrong execution mechanism. S period sample: $243 theoretical cost difference if Bosona had taken instead of made (avg 2.83¢/share across 116 maker fills).
findings.minimal_fix: Add execution model parameter to decide()/apply(): maker_cost(price)=price (no fee), taker_cost(price,rate)=price+rate*p*(1-p). Model limit order placement at bid (maker) vs immediate take at ask (taker). Add fill timing distribution (resting order fills over time, not discrete t=180/600).

findings.title: Tight value filters yield 3.6% entry rate (21/591)
findings.claim: Of 591 eligible scenarios (age==180 decision data available), only 21 (3.6%) enter due to value filters: prob-cost≥0.05 and price≤0.55.
findings.evidence: results/replay_filtering.json: 816 universe → 591 eligible → 21 entered. Entry rejection breakdown from F/results/entry_rows.json: 262 fail price>55¢, 149 fail prob<5%, 159 execution_proxy_rejected.
findings.affected: 570/591 eligible markets rejected. Entry scarcity by design, not bug.
findings.minimal_fix: None - working as designed. If higher entry rate desired, relax filters (lower edge threshold or raise price ceiling), but this changes strategy risk profile.

findings.title: Only 1 addition in 21 entries (4.8% addition rate)
findings.claim: Of 21 markets that entered, only 1 added at t=600. 9 neutralized early (completion before t=600 → net=0), others failed value filters at t=600.
findings.evidence: results/replay_filtering.json: 1 add_event out of 21 entered scenarios. candidate.py:66-72 addition requires abs(net)>0 and same value filters. results/early_neutralization.json: 9/21 scenarios completed before t=600 (early net reset).
findings.affected: 20/21 entered markets have no addition. Early neutralization is structural (if market moves to complete position, net=0 prevents addition).
findings.minimal_fix: None - structural behavior. Addition at t=600 requires unmatched position AND value edge AND price ceiling. If early completion closes position, addition impossible. This is correct logic for risk-reducing strategy.

findings.title: unit_cost() formula correct for taker, does not implement maker fee
findings.claim: unit_cost(price, rate) = price + rate*price*(1-price) correctly implements official taker fee formula, but does not distinguish maker fee (0) or rebate (20% for BTC).
findings.evidence: candidate.py:12-15 unit_cost() definition. docs.polymarket.com/trading/fees: taker fee = C×feeRate×p×(1-p), maker fee=0 plus 15-25% rebate. results/unit_cost_verification.json: formula matches official, but no maker/rebate logic.
findings.affected: All cost calculations assume taker fee. At p=0.5, taker pays 0.5175, maker net 0.4965 (with rebate), difference 2.10¢/share.
findings.minimal_fix: Add maker_unit_cost(price, rebate_rate=0.2): return price - rebate_rate*0.07*price*(1-price). Use in apply() when modeling maker execution. Requires execution model parameter (maker vs taker).

findings.title: Portfolio and cross-market limits not implemented

findings.minimal_fix: Add portfolio state to replay() or live execution: track open_worst_loss across all markets, count new_risk_markets, enforce limits in allowed(). For single-market backtest (current replay()), no change needed.

summary:
BTC15dk piyasalarında emir kimliği (orderHash) analizi tamamlandı. 34 piyasada 303 transaction, 1076 fill, 938 benzersiz orderHash incelendi.

**Karar değiştiren bulgular:**

1. **Activity API eksikliği** (D3-F1): Activity API her tx için sadece 1 satır gösteriyor, ama zincirde ortalama 3.55 fill var. %89.4 tx birden fazla token içeriyor ancak activity sadece bir outcome raporluyor. 773 maker fill (çoğu alternatif outcome'da) activity'de görünmüyor.

2. **Geç ekleme yanlış yorumu** (D3-F2): 197 "geç ekleme" (age≥600) tespit edildi; bunların HİÇBİRİ erken başlayan bir orderHash'in devamı değil, TÜMÜ yeni emir yerleştirmesi (197/197 = %100 yeni parent). Önceki yorumlarda "mevcut emrin devam eklenmesi" olarak anlaşılmış olabilir.

**Önemli doğrulamalar:**

3. **Maker/taker dağılımı** (D3-F3): 773 maker / 303 taker fill (2.55:1), eşit paylarla (30,957.33 share her biri). Çok sayıda küçük taker fill, birden fazla maker fill ile eşleşiyor.

4. **Paketleme undercount** (D3-F5): 1/5/10 sn zaman pencereleriyle yapılan emir sayımı, gerçek orderHash'in ~1/5-1/7'sini sayıyor (oran 5.1, 5.8, 6.8). Zamansal paketleme davranış sınıflandırması için orderHash'ten daha kaba.

**Yapısal sınırlar:**

5. **Emir ömrü ölçülemez** (D3-F4): Zincir sadece fill event'lerini içeriyor, emir oluşturma/iptal zamanı yok. İlk-son dolum arası süre (0-6 block) ölçülebilir ama bu ALT sınır.

**Diğer gözlemler:**

6. Mixed-side tx: %23.1 tx'te hem Up hem Down alışı var. Rol ataması fill bazında yapılmalı, tx bazında değil.

7. Karma rol emirleri: Sadece %0.5 orderHash hem maker hem taker olmuş. Tipik davranış tek rol (%99.5).
